import torch

```{r}
seurat.merged <- readRDS("~/seurat.merged.rds")

keep <- which(!is.na(seurat.merged$cloneType))
seurat.merged$barcode <- seurat.merged@assays$RNA@data@Dimnames[2]
seurat.merged <- subset(seurat.merged, barcode %in% names(keep))
table(seurat.merged$cloneType)
asdf <- seurat.merged

asdf$malig <- asdf$cloneType == "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)"

df <- data.frame(cell_type=asdf$malig)
table(df$cell_type)
df$barcode <- rownames(df)
df <- df %>% group_by(cell_type) %>% slice_sample(n=100000, replace = F)
asdf.ss <- subset(asdf, barcode %in% df$barcode)

x <- asdf.ss@assays$RNA@data
summary(rowSums(x))
med <- which(rowSums(x) > 1000)
x <- x[med,]
x <- ScaleData(x)


labels <- asdf.ss$malig
labels <- as.numeric(labels)
table(labels)
```



```{python}
device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
#device = torch.device('cpu')
data = r.x
labels = r.labels

scaler = MinMaxScaler()
scaled_data = scaler.fit_transform(data)
input_data = torch.tensor(scaled_data, dtype=torch.float32)

print(input_data.size())
input_data_transposed = input_data.t()

print(input_data_transposed.size())

input_data_transposed = input_data_transposed[:100000, :]
print(input_data_transposed.size())
# Convert binary labels to PyTorch tensor
target_labels = torch.tensor(labels)  # Assuming the labels are of 'long' type
target_labels = target_labels[:100000]
print(target_labels.size())
```




```{python}

# Define your neural network
class NeuralNetwork(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, hidden_size, output_size):
        super(NeuralNetwork, self).__init__()
        self.layer1 = nn.Linear(input_size, hidden_size)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()  # ReLU activation
        self.layer2 = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
        self.layer3 = nn.Linear(hidden_size, output_size)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.layer1(x)
        x = self.relu(x)
        x = self.layer2(x)
        x = self.relu(x)
        x = self.layer3(x)
        return x


# Define input size, hidden size, output size
input_size = 13179
hidden_size = 128
output_size = 1

# Create the model
model = NeuralNetwork(input_size, hidden_size, output_size)
model = model.to(device)
target_labels = target_labels.to(device)
input_data_transposed = input_data_transposed.to(device)


# Define loss function and optimizer
criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()  # Binary Cross Entropy Loss for binary classification
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)  # Adam optimizer

num_epochs = 250
print_interval = 1
losses = []
auc_values = []

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    outputs = model(input_data_transposed)
    loss = criterion(outputs.squeeze(), target_labels)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()

    losses.append(loss.item())

    if (epoch + 1) % print_interval == 0:
        print(f'Epoch [{epoch + 1}/{num_epochs}], Loss: {loss.item():.4f}')

    # Calculate AUC
    outputs = torch.sigmoid(outputs)  # Apply sigmoid
    predictions = outputs.cpu().detach().numpy()
    target_labels_cpu = target_labels.cpu()
    auc = roc_auc_score(target_labels_cpu.numpy(), predictions)
    auc_values.append(auc)

# Plotting the loss curve
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.plot(range(1, num_epochs + 1), losses, label='Training Loss')
plt.xlabel('Epochs')
plt.ylabel('Loss')
plt.title('Training Loss Curve')
plt.legend()
plt.show()

# Plotting the AUC curve
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.plot(range(1, num_epochs + 1), auc_values, label='AUC')
plt.xlabel('Epochs')
plt.ylabel('AUC')
plt.title('AUC Curve')
plt.legend()
plt.show()

```
